name: Garlic Parmesan Pasta
desc: Fettuccine simmered in one pan with garlic butter, chicken broth and milk, then finished with Parmesan.

source.title: One Pot Garlic Parmesan Pasta
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (2 tbsp butter, 4 garlic cloves, 2 cups broth, 1 cup milk, 8 oz fettuccine, 1/4 cup Parmesan, 2 tbsp parsley) and the same 18-20 minute simmer.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup milk, plus more as needed
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

steps: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the broth, milk, and fettuccine and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally so the pasta does not stick, until the pasta is tender, 18-20 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan. If it is too thick, stir in more milk until it reaches the consistency you like.
Serve right away, garnished with parsley.

references.title: One Pot Garlic Parmesan Pasta
references.usedFor: servings, heat level, thinning with milk
